Building permit granted Dec 2024. In October 2023 BayWa said the site, up to 8,000 m² in the Mon area about 10 km west of Ed, could hold up to 75 MWh and be in place during 2026, depending on grid capacity (Dalslänningen, 24 Oct 2023). BayWa now gives 75 MW; energy capacity not confirmed.

location: Lagered 12:1 (municipal land), south-east of Knäred, Laholm, Halland
notes: About 70 MW of container batteries on about 2 ha. Laholm municipality approved the land lease in August 2023 and road access agreements in March 2026 (minutes, 10 Mar 2026, § 52). Separate from Primora's 1 MW Knäred battery. Energy capacity and timeline not published.

About 70 MW on about 4 ha. Neoen held the consultation and got its permits during 2025; in 2026 it is in talks with the regional grid company about the connection (Neoen project page). Separate from Nybro Energi's own 5 MW and 12 MW batteries. Energy capacity and timeline not published.

location: Häggatorp 10:1, south-west of Kallinge, Ronneby, Blekinge
notes: About 70 MW of container batteries on about 2 ha. Building permit applied for Q4 2024 and in legal force from spring 2025; technical design and grid connection under review with the grid owner (Landinfra project page). Energy capacity and timeline not published.
Building permit granted May 2025 for about 1 ha; detailed design and grid connection work under way. BayWa plans commissioning in 2029. Energy capacity not published.

Building permit granted April 2026 for up to about 73 containers, about 40 expected (1,130 m²), plus a substation, near a large overhead power line. Investment about SEK 300 million, for arbitrage and frequency services. Awaiting grid owner Ellevio before a connection agreement; connection estimated mid-2029 because of long transformer lead times. A solar park is planned next to it around 2030 (Filipstads Tidning, 18 Apr 2026). Separate from Axpo's Filipstad project.

notes: Announced March 2024 as the largest battery park in the Nordics: about 1 ha, with Polar Structure owning the equipment, Bodens Energi the local grid and Vattenfall the regional grid. First due during 2024, later autumn 2025 (Second Opinion, Jan 2025). No confirmation it was built.

Construction start date not stated.
Up to 25 MW battery with 34 ha solar park; permit granted by Länsstyrelsen Halland 2026.

developer: Cloudberry Clean Energy (developed by Sunna Group)
notes: Cloudberry bought the project from Sunna Group in June 2026. It has a grid connection agreement, land rights and a building permit; design and procurement under way, with ready-to-build status expected during 2026 and operation by 2027 (Sunna Group, 17 Jun 2026; Cloudberry Q2 2026 report).

developer: Rocmore Energy & Pyrios (developed by RES, SCR and Alingsås Energi)
notes: Connects at one of Alingsås Energi's transformer stations. RES and SCR started the project with Alingsås Energi in 2023 and sold it to Rocmore Energy, which bought it with Pyrios; ready to move into construction in September 2024 and expected to be finished by summer 2025. Site per Alingsås Tidning. No confirmation it was built. Energy capacity not published.
Notification approved Oct 2024, building permit May 2025.

developer: Stella Futura (now Polarium), hosted by Härjeåns
location: Next to Härjeåns' CHP plant, Sveg, Härjedalen, Jämtland
notes: Härjeåns signed a battery-as-a-service agreement in November 2023: Stella Futura to deliver, install and operate a 15 MW system for grid services to Svenska kraftnät, ready in spring 2024. Stella Futura owns the battery and pays for it, leasing the land from Härjeåns: five containers on a 2,500 m² plot next to the CHP plant, described as the first battery connected to a CHP plant in Sweden, with a 17-year life, for ancillary services and price arbitrage (Östersunds-Posten, 25 Nov 2023). 18.7 MWh is from an earlier hand-collected list; Härjeåns gives no MWh. No confirmation it was built or commissioned.

developer: Ingrid Capacity (project company Ingrid Capacity Skövde 1 AB)
location: Ryd 15:44, next to an existing substation across road 26 from Ryd, Skövde, Västra Götaland
online: Mid-2026 (hoped for in May 2025; not confirmed)
notes: Ingrid Capacity told Skaraborgs Allehanda (10 May 2025) it wanted to build a 12 MW / 24 MWh system in Ryd and hoped to start building in autumn 2025 and run from mid-2026. A building permit for battery storage on Ryd 15:44 followed in June 2025 (Skövde building committee). No construction or start-up reported.

Building permit granted September 2026 for a battery with 10 MW maximum power: nine units (four battery containers, four inverter containers, transformers and a substation) on about 600 m² (Skaraborgs Allehanda, 27 Sep 2026). Developer and energy capacity not published.

location: Aspnäs, north of Tämnaren, outside Östervåla, Heby, Uppsala County
notes: Heby's building and environment committee granted a building permit in December 2025 for the buildings of a combined solar park and battery storage on farmland: 32 transformer stations, five switchgear buildings and battery containers, about 1,100 m² in total. Construction planned 2026, completion 2027; Vattenfall to provide the grid connection (Sala Allehanda, 20 Dec 2025). Sizes not published.

Two 10 MWh units in an enclosed building designed for cold weather; Monsson is the EPC contractor and keeps full ownership and operation. Power not published.

At least 20 MW; building permit process underway. Energy capacity not published.
